control.name: preset_combo
control.tip: HandBrake preset JSON from the Handbrake folder. Defines encoder, format, and default quality.

control.name: maxside_edit
control.tip: Longest side in pixels (--maxWidth / --maxHeight). Video is scaled down if larger; not upscaled.

control.name: quality_edit
control.tip: HandBrake -q for larger files (same as Video Quality slider). Leave blank to use the preset. Lower = higher quality (x265 CQ).

control.name: framerate_edit
control.tip: HandBrake -r frame rate in fps. Leave blank to use the preset.

control.name: smallsize_cutoff_edit
control.tip: Size cutoff in MB. Files smaller than this use -q / -r on this row. Leave cutoff and -q blank to disable.

control.name: smallsize_quality_edit
control.tip: Quality (-q) for files under the MB cutoff. Required with cutoff; larger files use Video quality above or the preset.

control.name: smallsize_framerate_edit
control.tip: Frame rate (-r) for files under the MB cutoff. Optional; leave blank to use Frame rate above or the preset.

control.name: framerange_start_edit
control.tip: First frame to encode (--start-at frames:N). Leave blank to start at frame 0.

control.name: framerange_end_edit
control.tip: Last frame to encode, inclusive. Uses --stop-at frames:(count). Leave blank to encode to the end.
